descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S31 Retention and purge are running on production: purge jobs registered, last run green, windows equal 3.6

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T6 Retention and purge are live in production (TFA-94699), as part of the PHI gate. Behavior is tested in OAT-04; here it is a gate item only. (TFA-94059 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim, reading the production Convex dashboard (scheduled functions and crons, function logs, env names); no patient data read

When Capture, dated: the registered crons, with the lifecycle purge jobs and their last runs; the retention configuration values the purge uses (configuration, not hard-coded, per 3.6); and the OAT-04 result on production, attached (per Q10).

Then Every lifecycle purge job is registered and has a successful run in the last 24 h. The retention values equal the 3.6 Hospital and Nursing Home windows. The OAT-04 production result is attached.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94059 AC 7 'Retention and purge live in prod (TFA-94699)', as part of the PHI gate. A missing purge job, a failing last run, or a window different from 3.6 is a Fail, quoted with the job or value. Purge behavior itself is OAT-04.

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S31 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: CONFIG · Config check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
